title: Manifest Convergence Tracking
description: Manifests with convergence_target=empty_diff are tracked toward actual empty-diff verdicts. Surface 'X of N converged' as a top-level scenario-health metric.

requirements.title: Convergence counter + dashboard surface
requirements.description: Aggregate query over manifests where convergence_target=empty_diff: count how many have a most-recent verdict of pass with empty diff. Expose as a single number + ratio on the dashboard index and per-golden views.
